messages.text:
The build and backend checks are still green; the remaining e2e failures are interaction-layer issues, not server/build issues.

I’m making the preview robust by handling card clicks at the article level and strengthening the dock stacking rule so mobile actions sit above card media, then I’ll rerun e2e.
